what: Alpaca quantity-coverage gap is detected but never re-armed. MEASURED 2026-09-29 via /api/diag/alpaca_order_history: paper rows 6023 (QQQ 22 sh, alpaca_paper), 6024 (QQQ 56 sh, alpaca_portfolio) and 6131 (SPY 8 sh, alpaca_paper) had their entry-bracket legs lapse at 20:00Z on the entry day (day-TIF, before the 09-27 GTC change) and were never re-armed, because a sibling row's OCO on the same symbol made AlpacaClient.protection_state read stop=True at symbol level; the partially_naked grade in _check_broker_naked_equity_positions is alert-only by design (BL-20260908). New entries are GTC, so the day-lapse trigger is gone, but any other way a sibling's legs disappear (fill of one row's stop, 90-day aged-order cancel) leaves the same gap. PR #14127's same-size/unknown-size logic does NOT change this: it acts inside a re-arm, and none is ever called here. Needs an operator-visible decision: bind a quantity-scoped re-arm to the partially_naked grade (Tier 2 order path).
